findings.reason: 'Thêm' is this locale's established word for the ADD action (ui.chat.tags.add = 'Thêm'); the sidebar row it labels is a disclosure that reveals additional navigation destinations, not an add control. The house style for 'More <things>' is 'khác' (ui.agents.navigation.legacy.more_actions: 'More agent actions' -> 'Thao tác khác với tác nhân').

This is the aria-label of the same overflow disclosure (sidebar-navigation.tsx:1182,1206), so it reads to a screen reader as 'Add destination(s)' - an action the control does not perform. 'Các điểm đến khác' states 'other destinations' and matches the 'khác' convention used for 'More agent actions'.

findings.observation: REPRODUCED at render: the caller passes filters.tagMode.toUpperCase() (library-filter-rail.tsx:311-312), so this correct catalogue string renders 'Nhãn khớp ALL' / 'Nhãn khớp ANY' with an untranslated English enum. The fix is code-side (map all/any to Vietnamese words); the catalogue itself preserves {mode} correctly and needs no change.

Relative-age fragments run ~1.8x the English character count (12 phút trước = 13 chars vs 12m ago = 7), but they are the shortest idiomatic Vietnamese form; no abbreviation is standard. Rendered QA should confirm narrow card metadata does not truncate. The same class was accepted as an observation in the hi audit.

Pre-existing, outside this file: ui.projects translates English 'asset' as 'tài sản' ('Hiển thị {name}, tài sản {index} trên {count}'), while this new catalogue and the rest of the file surfaces use the stated call 'tệp'. Not introduced by this change; recorded for a future consistency pass.
